name: @cloudcli-ai/desktop
description: Self-contained local desktop application for CloudCLI
author: CloudCLI UI Contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:runtime: node scripts/build-root.mjs && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run rebuild:runtime
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:runtime:mac && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:runtime:win && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win --x64 --publish never
